book.name: LOMA
book.title: Loma wali Leta Pol wana Leleli

content: Keliso I Ahela Ta Nok Avala Yehoba Ta Mibubun ge Ta Yaliyaya
Wala abulilek kaiwena Yehoba iyaka i awa sapusapu-agila, inoke avala ta mibubun. Mibubun o i masalem wala Babala Yeisu Keliso eliyana,

kaiwena i ahela ta nok Yehoba elana ge Yehoba wana mulolu bwagabwaga ta pwawa, heiya te sauga ya elana ta minaa. I ola al, wala yaliyaya i bwata, kaiwena ta atimatuwa te bwaliga avala Yehoba wana wasawasa ta ahe toyawe.
Ge bugul etega al, ebo lomwan ta pwawa, he ta yaliyaya-an al to, kaiwena ta atena lomwan palahikan i tal yawalila elana,
ge palahikan enona heiya yawalila ni ola yawal toto Yehoba nuwana, ge toto ya enona heiya alona wala atimatuwa ta matamatan Yehoba ni pawasawasa-agila.
Ta atena atimatuwa o iya atimatuwa enona gaganina, kaiwena Yehoba Yayaluwa Bwabwalena elana wana nunuwana i ligin atela i pakalaopopwi. Yayaluwa Bwabwalena o Yehoba i pem ala mulolu.
He i ola hiwe. Sauga kila iyoho ta pwepweyata, inoke ana sauga hot elana toto Yehoba i lovivina-an, Keliso i yaomal kilau Yehoba ana toawatautau kaiwela.
Sauga enuna ya te gamagal etega yawalina ni talamwan alona kaiwena. Yaa tabam bosowaina gamagal etega totona ni talamwan ni yaomal gamagal toto wana pagan waiwaisana kaiwena.
Yaa Yehoba wana nunuwana ana bwata i pankitela i ola hiwe: sauga kila iyoho gegi paganina elana te Keliso i yaomal kaiwela.
Keliso wana yaomal kaiwena Yehoba iyaka i awa sapusapu-agila, inoke ta atena bubun bwaliga Keliso ni pwamwalila Yehoba wana huga elana.

Valila kila Yehoba ana topihigelgel, yaa Natuna wana yaomal eliyana iya ge kila maninila iyaka ta abubun ge ta heliheliyam. He i ola, inoke ta atena bubun bwaliga Keliso ni pwamwalila, kaiwena yawalina i gan.
Ge bugul etega al, wala Babala Yeisu Keliso eliyana Yehoba ta yaliyaya-an, kaiwena Yeisu iyaka i ahela ta na alola Yehoba ta heliheliyam.
Adama elana Ta Yaomal, Keliso elana Yawalila Ta Pwawa
Tau maisena wana ginol eliyana inoke gegi i masal panayawiya, ge gegi yaomal i pwatanim. Inoke yaomal i kalapapanet gamagalau gegewel elal, kaiwena gegewel hi gegi.

He mulaa abwe Yehoba logugui i pek Mosese elana, gegi paganina iyoho i gangan ya panayawiya. Adama wana sauga elana i nem ana siga Mosese wana sauga, Mosese wana Logugui nigeya ga i gagan gamagalau elal. Inoke nige bosowaina ta ba, “Gamagalau o logugui hi leke heliya togegi.” Yaa tunahot heliya togegi. Bwagana nige wali gegi i oola Adama wana gegi, iya Yehoba wana logugui i leke, yaa gamagalau o gegewel heliya togegi yaka yaomal i logugui-agil. Adama iya i ola tau toto mulaa abwe i nem kakanununa.

Yaa Yehoba wana guyau bwagabwaga nige i oola Adama wana sogu. Tunahot tau maisena wana sogu kaiwena gamagalau hi gewi hi yaomal. Yaa Yehoba wana mulolu bwagabwaga i bwata nabi ge guyau toto i neem tau maisena Yeisu Keliso wana mulolu eliyana i waisi hot, yaka gamagalau hi gewi hi pwawa.

I ola al Yehoba wana guyau enowana ge gamagal maisena wana gegi enowana nige hi oolaolaek. Adama i gegi pamaisena, yaka Yehoba i payatala ge i baek elana i ba, “Wam gegi lahena nu pwawa.” Yaa gamagalau hi gewi hi gegi Yehoba i muloluagil i baek elal i ba, “Komiu ku sapu.”

Ge tunahot tau maisena wana sogu eliyana yaomal gamagalau gegewel i logugui-agil. Yaa bolo Yehoba wana mulolu kalakalaopopwina hi ahe ge i awa sapusapu-agil, heliya yawal hot nihi ahe ge nihi tologugui tau maisena Yeisu Keliso wana waisi eliyana.

Inoke i ola hiwe. Adama i sogu, yaka gamagalau gegewel hi minaa Yehoba wana lahi elana. I ola al, Keliso i ginol pasapu, yaka Yehoba gamagalau gegewel ni awa sapusapu-agil ge yawaliliya hot ni pek elal.
Ge tau maisena Yehoba anana nige i hahago, yaka gamagalau gegewel hi tabwa togegi. I ola al, tau maisena Yehoba anana i hago, yaka gamagalau gegewel nihi tabwa tosapu.
He abwe Mosese wana Logugui al i vin, inoke abwe gegi ana aatena i bwata. Yaa bwagana gamagalau wali gegi i bwata nabi, he Yehoba wana mulolu i bwata nabiyan hot.

Inoke valila gegi i gasisi gamagalau i logugui-agil, ana abapwamowasi yaomal hi pwawa. Yaa sauga ya Yehoba wana mulolu i gasisi, kaiwena i awa sapusapu-agila, ana abapwamowasi yawal mihomihotina ta pwawa Yeisu Keliso wala Babala eliyana.
